text:
mira: RFC follow-up - lightweight "input-risk" at the edge to trigger fast fallbacks.

mira: Problem: some errors only reproduce for certain request shapes. Controller lag means customer-visible failures before we flip routes.

oz: idea ack. if we compute a cheap risk vector inline we can short-circuit to a safe variant immediately. needs strict privacy rules.

raj: sketch RiskVector fields: token_count, embeddings_flag, attachment_count, feature_flag_count, latency_pred(0-1), fingerprint_hash. all primitives, no raw text.

taylor: add: attachment_size_bucket and model_call_count. keep ops O(1) per request.

mira: decision flow: 1) router builds RiskVector. 2) if any local_threshold breached -> immediate local fallback. 3) else ship RiskVector (only) to controller for canary scoring during the window.

oz: local_thresholds should be configurable per-tenant + per-route. default: latency_pred>0.9 or attachment_count>3 triggers fallback.

raj: controller scoring: weighted sum of aggregated vectors over window_secs. require min_samples and cooldown to actually flip a route to avoid reacting to spikes.

taylor: sample policy prototype: `{"window_secs":"600","sample_rate":"0.05","local_thresholds":"{\"latency\":\"0.9\",\"attachments\":\"3\"}","min_samples":"50","cooldown_secs":"120"}`

mira: privacy: fingerprint_hash must be salted per-deployment; full payloads can only be sampled at 0.01 with automated PII redaction.

oz: private deployments: support `local_only_mode` where controller calls are disabled and all decisions live on router config. important for air-gapped customers.

raj: stability knobs: min_samples, cooldown_secs, hysteresis_ratio. flipping a route requires score > threshold *and* score > prev_score * hysteresis_ratio.

taylor: perf: vector calc is sub-ms if we avoid scans/regex. use counters from parsing stage (tokenizer provides token_count cheaply).

mira: ops testing: chaos test that sends large attachments + high token streams. expect fallback within 200ms and no controller flip if isolated.

deploy-bot: applied canary_policy to svc=text-gen-staging (deploy-5122) :white_check_mark:

oz: next steps: mira will draft small proto for RiskVector and privacy appendix. i'll take router changes.

raj: i'll prototype controller scoring algorithm and provide a sim.

taylor: i'll define dashboards and SLOs for false-fallback rate and detection latency.

mira: thanks team. will post RFC patch with proto and sample configs by EOD tomorrow.
